name: Porcini Mushroom
siboNotes: High mannitol content can trigger SIBO symptoms even in small amounts. Consider using dried porcini powder in very small quantities for flavor.
preparationTips: Use dried porcini powder sparingly for umami flavor without large volume
Limit fresh porcini to very small amounts as garnish
Soak dried porcini and use only the strained liquid for cooking
Combine with low-FODMAP vegetables to reduce overall portion size
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in protein and B vitamins
Good source of potassium and selenium
